title: Environs - Abandoned Abodes - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 8 NPCs from Environs - Abandoned Abodes.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Environs - Abandoned Abodes (Environs - Abandoned Abodes.esp).

Install this if Environs - Abandoned Abodes.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
